main.description: Individuals or entities taking part in a deliberation process.

country.description: The country of origin of a participant (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code).

hasRole.description: Relates a participant to their role in a deliberation.

identifier.description: A unique identifier for an entity.

isAffiliatedWith.description: Relates a participant to organizations they are affiliated with.

participantType.description: The type or status of participant (e.g., EU_CITIZEN, NON_EU_CITIZEN, COMPANY, NGO, PUBLIC_AUTHORITY, ACADEMIC_RESEARCH_INSTITUTION).
